TRANSPORT TOWN — OFFLINE CLASSROOM GAME

1. Extract this ZIP folder anywhere on the computer.
2. Open the extracted folder.
3. Double-click index.html to open the game in Chrome, Edge, or Firefox.

No account, sign-in, or internet connection is required after extraction.

For classroom use, connect the laptop to the TV and use the on-screen buttons
or the keyboard shortcuts shown in the game.

Important: Keep the audio folder, the background picture, and all other files
in the same extracted folder as index.html. Do not open index.html from inside
the ZIP file.
